This update was also given the name '''Content Creators Update''', as this update added the [[Content Creator Skins]]. This version encompassed four updates, the main v1.12.0 update (released 28 January 2024) and three minor updates, v1.12.0a (released 28 January 2024), v1.12.0b (released 31 January 2024) and v1.12.0c (released 31 January 2024). ==Additions== *Content Creator skins for the [[Daily Store]]. **{{Color|ContentCreator|Corso}} [[Crook Boss]] **{{Color|ContentCreator|Eggrypted}} [[Commander]] Revenge Event]] *Removed everything related to the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] from the lobby, with the exception of [[Quests#Santa Quests|Santa Quests]]. ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Tower icons in the inventory and tower hotbar now use decal icons instead of viewport icons. *Towers, units and enemies are now streamlined into the client, improving performance. *Content Creator skins have a here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.12.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|ContentCreatorSkinsUpdate.png|🎥 CONTENT CREATOR SKINS 🛠️}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|📹Added [[Content Creator Skins]]}} *Corso [[Crook Boss]] *Eggrypted [[Commander]] *Wikia [[Engineer]] *Propellars [[Ranger]] *Sweaking [[Minigunner]] *Elite [[Accelerator]] *Isaac [[Warden]] {{UpdateH3|🛒Updated Daily Skins}} *[[Content Creator skins]] have been added to the daily skin rotation! *Skins will appear in the daily rotation for the next 30 days! *Expect more skins to be added alongside Content Creators! {{UpdateH3|🔧Improvements}} *[[Towers]] are now changed from using viewports to using icons *[[Towers]] are now streamed into the client *[[Units]] are now streamed into the client *[[Enemies]] are now streaming on demand into the client *Client FPS should be higher and more stable *Client memory usage should be lower by ~1gb *Duplicate textures have been removed *We are continuing on working on more optimizations {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.12.0-Image1.png|[[Towers]] using icons instead of viewports}} {{UpdateH3|⏳Ready Button}} *Added a ready button to the lobby! *Now the game will start when everyone is ready *The counter will start when anyone presses the button {{UpdateThumbnail|V1.12.0-Image2.png|Click the button to ready up!}} {{UpdateH3|📜[[Mission Quests]]}} *Expect [[mission quests]] to be coming out sometime next early month! *More info will be posted on our socials!👀 }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.12.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
